notes.title: Act IV

notes.title: Act III
notes.notes:
Patch 0.3 Notes:

Updates:

Act 3 added- Highlands area + new ?? boss added.
UI got a facelift.
Attacks now reduce shield bash / charge CD.
Demon health reduced from 2500 to 2000
DNACS possessed duration reduced from 20 sec to 15 and internal CD increased from 30 sec to 60 sec.
Resolution scaling option added.
Dragon-themed load screen artwork added.

Bug Fixes:

Mobs will now politely wait and not attack while you are zoning.
Fixed dismount / weapon sheathe bug.
Oh so many minor bug fixes

notes.title: Deeeeeeemon!
notes.notes:
Patch 0.2 Notes:

Act II released for alpha testing!

New Content:
-New level after mountain pass: the Monastery
-Act II boss in the basement of the Monastery
-Optional/side quest puzzle**gamepad keybinds not yet set up for puzzle, must use mouse**
-Bonus piece of equipment added
-DNACS (Definitely Not A Cursed Sword) is now appropriately cursed

New Features:
-Gamepad Controller Support for Xbox style controllers. Recommended over keyboard and mouse! (All Keybinds for keyboard and mouse as well as controller layout are still not yet rebindable except for swapping attack and block with a controller)
-Experience System
-Talent System
-Equipment system updated- can now scroll thru and change your weap/shield (previously N/A due to lack of options)
-Steam Achievements added

Alpha/beta test level skip buttons added to menu, so you have the option to skip what you've already played through.

Various minor bugs fixed.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes: In the demo, when you click "new game", after selecting a difficulty, you will now have the option to skip directly to the witch boss fight! Also added a discord link button on the main menu.

notes.title: The Witch
notes.notes:
Patch 0.1 Notes:

Rudimentary combat system added.
Bats/tree monsters added.
Inventory system added.
Healing Potion system added.
Cursed Forest traps added.
Witch boss fight at her house added. Sorry not sorry about THAT stick... #fortheluls. You'll know it when you see it.
Boss fight attempt # tracker added- lmk how many attempts it takes you to beat the witch so I can take an average to gauge difficulty (or how many attempts before you gave up, wiTchever applies).
Keybinds 1-4 for dialog responses added. 
You may now press "1" to advance/close any dialog box instead of clicking on the checkmark/X.
Main menu feature once you beat the demo added.
Autosave & load functionality added.
Added master volume controls.
Difficulty settings added.
Alternative camera/character control style added.
Adding added.
Use of the word "added" repeatedly added.

Timing window to dodge witch teleport spell increased from 1.0 to 1.5 seconds.
Render targets (equipment/character portraits) optimized: should see about 10-20 increased FPS, most noticeable in the Cursed Forest.
Venturing into the forest unarmed was more popular than I imagined- you can now break out of the roots even while unarmed instead of autodying. 
95% of development playtesting was done on the spin cycle... recommend using that combo (which is the default) for smoothest results.

Bug Fixes:

You can no longer glide across the bridge gap by spamming shield block.
Fixed Movement stutter during chat events.
Fixed issue where if player spams dodge key during initial witch event, camera ends up stuck in the forest where you can't see whats going on. Dodge now has a short cooldown.
Fixed issue where, on death, player would sometimes randomly appear at the mountain pass entrance instead of the beginning of the forest.
Disabled Lost in Cursed Forest reset widget- caused too many issues / isn't really necessary. Just don't get lost, or if you do, die or load for a reset. Plenty of things around to kill you now.
Dialog Box raidboss nerfed. Can now push "1" to advance/close any dialog box.
Input buffer added... during attack, if you right click and hold before your attack finishes, you will now begin shielding as soon as the attack ends. This does not help you if your attack is interrupted due to damage, however.
Fixes reload vs restart level issues and added a confirmation box for level restart.
Fixed issue with tree monsters still damaging you as they die, as well as ending their melee trace the moment you've successfully blocked their attack.
Fixed issues with Witch "fake-casting"- starting one spell, canceling it, and switching to another.
You can now turn while rooted.
